design_archetype: Organic & Earthy (Trust, Growth, Calm + Municipal Tactile)

typography.heading_font: Cabinet Grotesk / Outfit / Plus Jakarta Sans
guidelines: DO NOT use Inter for main headings. Reserve Inter/DM Sans for crisp body text and form controls.
Use Polish diacritics support for all font imports (Ł, ą, ę, ś, ć, ż, ź, ó, ń).
Headings must evoke eco-trust: rounded yet precise letterforms with tight tracking.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Mobile-First PWA UX with generous touch targets (min 48px height) and large intuitive buttons.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6
spacing_and_layout.header_nav: Sticky header with backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 border-b border-emerald-100 z-50 h-16 px-4

guidelines: Use smooth staggered fade-in lists for tree passports, work history timeline, and resident reports.
Provide micro-animations on QR code scanning toggles and image comparison sliders (before/after).

hero_and_nature.description: Towering oak tree with spring foliage in Łódź municipal park
City park in Poland with mature trees and wooden bench

worker_and_arborist.description: Arborist performing tree care and branch pruning

accessibility_rules: All interactive buttons and links must have touch target area of at least 44px by 44px.
Form inputs must have visible, high-contrast labels and error messages in Polish.
Color badges must combine text labels with contrasting background colors so colorblind users can identify status.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a cohesive, multi-tenant UI for Arbotag in Polish with 4 main roles/flows: 1) Public Resident, 2) Resident Portal (PESEL auth), 3) Worker Portal (Tree service card, work log, before/after photos), 4) Gmina Admin & Platform Owner Dashboards.
Follow the Organic & Earthy palette with lush greens (#2D6A4F), soft pale backgrounds (#F8FAF6), terracotta accents (#D97706), and high-contrast dark text (#1E293B).
Ensure all buttons are large, rounded, and easily clickable on mobile screens (PWA experience).
Attach unique `data-testid` attributes to every primary form input, table, switch, and CTA button.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on headers, dropdowns, or modal dialogs.
